title: Sodium hexafluorophosphate mediated enhancement of electrical and electrochemical properties of poly(vinyl alcohol)–chitosan solid polymer electrolytes for EDLCs
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24350-24366
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02897C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Vipin Cyriac, Ismayil, Kuldeep Mishra, Ankitha Rao, Riyadh Abdekadir Khellouf, Saraswati P. Masti, I. M. Noor
A NaPF6-complexed PVA–chitosan solid polymer electrolyte was developed. Ion dynamics were studied using multiple formalisms. The EDLC device delivered 42.65 F g−1 specific capacitance, 5.4 W h kg−1 energy density, and 95 W kg−1 power density.
